description: Skip Anthropic OAuth/usage I/O when Claude provider is disabled. userStories.description:
Materialize the dual-predicate contract that FEAT-001/002 implement. Write the contract into the progress log (and optionally a short note under src/loop_engine/CLAUDE.md account-global section if a one-liner fits). This is the design SSoT — not a large doc dump.

DO: Define both predicates with exact names and semantics:
1) `claude_provider_enabled` = `resolve_models_config(&project_config.models, &project_config.routing).is_provider_enabled(Provider::Claude)` (fail-closed if Claude absent).
2) Pre-iteration: `usage_params.enabled = LOOP_USAGE_CHECK_ENABLED && claude_provider_enabled` — gates orchestrator `ensure_valid_token` + `account_usage_gate`.
3) Post-output RateLimit: `anthropic_account_io_allowed = claude_provider_enabled` only — env does NOT apply. When false: no `load_usage_info`, no `probe_rate_limit_lifted`, `api_reset_secs` always None; wait from parse_reset_from_output / fallback_wait / blackout_fallback_secs only.
4) Hang mapping: primary bug = indefinite OAuth refresh hang with Claude disabled; secondary = 5h wait after successful above-threshold usage load.
5) Non-goals: ureq timeouts, merge host, ensure_valid_token removal, auto-disable Claude on Grok enable.

DO NOT: Implement production code in this task (tests for pure helpers may live on FEAT-001). Do NOT collapse the two predicates into one bool.

Known-bad: documenting only 'skip when primary is Grok' would leave dual-provider (Grok primary + Claude enabled) incorrectly skipping Anthropic pre-check.
